# Wellness Mama

> > Wellness Mama provides simple, evidence-based answers for healthier families through recipes, natural remedies, wellness resources, and a popular podcast hosted by founder Katie Wells.

Wellness Mama is a trusted health and wellness resource founded by Katie Wells that emphasizes real food, natural living, and family health. The site features medically-reviewed content, a podcast distributed across major platforms (Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Google Podcasts, iHeartRadio, Pandora), curated product recommendations, and practical guides for natural home care.

## Key Topics

- Natural Living
- Real Food & Nutrition
- Family Health
- Wellness Community
- Katie Wells

- Healthy Meal Plans
- Founder Mission
